description: Labelled ground-truth corpus for static-extraction-audit (REN-02/04/05/06/07/08/10/11/12). Clean cases carry an empty expectation on purpose: they are the false-positive control. REN-12 cases list a check-id PREFIX (see measure_static_extraction.py's prefix matching), since REN-12 finding ids carry a per-instance content-hash suffix.

cases.label: clean
cases.note: Hydration text restated, price restated, freshness signal present, main/article boundary with high ratio, alt text and track present, no bare phone in script, no PDF.
